register.labelZh: READ 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: read something back 適合用於核對電話號碼、地址、預訂資料和其他重要內容。；read something out 可以用來向一群人讀出規則、指示、結果、名字和訊息。；read something into something 可以描述某人把說話、行為或沉默想得太多的情況。；這些表達能幫助你分辨核對資料、大聲讀出文字,以及解讀潛在意思這三種用途。
register.summaryEn: Read something back is useful when checking telephone numbers, addresses, booking details and other information. Read something out allows you to share rules, instructions, results, names and messages with a group. Read something into something helps you describe situations in which a person may be giving words, actions or silence more meaning than they really have. These expressions help you distinguish between checking information, reading words aloud and interpreting possible meanings.

fixedVariable.variableEn: Keep the same people, things, time and meaning. When using it or them, place the words as shown: read it back read it out read too much into it Read something back when the purpose is to check information. Read something out when the purpose is to let people hear written words. You may add to + somebody when you need to name the listener: read the number back to me read the notice out to the class
